sloka: गत्वा तु सरयूतोयं स्थावराणि चराणि च ।प्राप्य तत्तोयविक्लेदं देवलोकमुपागमन् ।। ७.११०.२६ ॥
transliteration: gatvā tu sarayūtoyaṁ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ।prāpya tattoyavikledaṁ devalokamupāgaman ।। 7.110.26 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, having gone to the water of Sarayu, both immobile and mobile beings, by obtaining the moistening from that water, attained the world of gods.
